snippet.title: Humanity Must Perish - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for Humanity Must Perish; a free, comedic visual novel.
Humanity Must Perish is a short game about an android who is tasked with deciding the fate of mankind.

Created by Zetsubou
https://zetsubou.games

Video by Amy Smith
https://twitter.com/amy_oai

Music by Eric Matyas
www.soundimage.org

Art by Sendo
https://twitter.com/Sendrawz
